description: Use when an agent is about to sign a transaction and must decide whether it will go through right now: one call that answers canSend with the facts behind it - the sender's balance, the gas this exact transaction needs, what it will cost, whether the node says it would revert, the nonce to use if earlier ones are still in flight, whether the destination is a contract, and how stale the chain head is. Replaces five separate reads. No API key, no account. $0.02 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

chain.description: base | ethereum | polygon | arbitrum | optimism. Defaults to base.

from.description: The address that would sign and pay.

value.description: Optional native amount in wei, as a decimal string.

name: evm_can_i_send
title: Can I send this transaction
